excerpt_note: The last 120 rows, in order. The source file is not valid UTF-8: its accented names are Mac Roman bytes. The excerpt decodes them as Mac Roman and writes UTF-8, so Chloë Sevigny, Lauren Vélez and Alexander Skarsgård read correctly; byte for byte otherwise, plus a final line break the source lacks.
engine: Arcas engine at origin/main 2235190, anomaly_hunter.agents.scan_agent.scan(columns, rows) at strength 5 (the default), every cell passed as text with spaces trimmed, as the pane sends it

excerpt_flags.reason: Status? is written "End" 15 times and "END" 76 times (same word, different capitals/spaces)

full_table_flags.reason: Status? is written "End" 17 times and "END" 202 times (same word, different capitals/spaces)

findings.what_was_wrong: Score/Y is Score divided by Years Since, and for Charles Dance, Patrick Dempsey and Ian McElhinney, whose characters left in 2015, Years Since is 0, so the published file carries the spreadsheet's #DIV/0! error instead of a number.
findings.right_value: unknown: a score per year is not defined for 0 years; the cell should be left empty or the rule changed. Checked: on all 245 other rows Score/Y equals Score / Years Since exactly.

findings.what_was_wrong: Status? is written End 17 times and END 202 times in the full table; the readme defines only END and LEFT.

other_excerpt_flags: none besides the above (one 'Noted' baseline line on #LEAD, below the pane's default list).
row_numbering: Row numbers are sheet rows: the header is row 1, so data row k (counting from 1) is sheet row k + 1. source_sheet_row is the same row in the full published file.
